podcast.body: This song is commonly remembered as a direct attack on the police. However, its lyrics contained profound discourse addressing issues such as indiscriminate arrests, racist attitudes, and police violence. Some members of Ni Ganswizatitude had personally experienced arbitrary detentions by racist police, which deeply informed the song's content. It is part of a politically complex album that extends beyond mere protest. "Es curioso porque siempre nos quedamos con las canciones como FACTE POLÍS, como un ataque a la policía cuando en el fondo eran discursos bastante profundos sobre detenciones indiscriminadas, actitudes racistas, violencia policial, algunos miembros incluso de nigas huidatitude habían sufrido esas detenciones arbitrarias por parte de la policía racista."
